name: Whiskerhold
summary: Whiskerhold is the contractor base and the first territory in the route.
role: Use Whiskerhold as a spawn location. The team does not need to capture this territory.
fun_facts: Whiskerhold is the only territory flagged as spawn-only.
Furry players cannot deploy from Whiskerhold.

name: Furward
summary: Furward is the first enemy territory after Whiskerhold.
role: Capture Furward to open a forward spawn location.
fun_facts: Furward is active in the full territory route but not the single-objective Rush version.

name: Furrow
summary: Furrow is the third territory. It is the only objective in Rush.
role: Capture Furrow in Traditional mode. Defend Furrow in Rush mode.
fun_facts: Rush starts Furrow in defender hands and ends badly if the Furries take it.

name: Purridge
summary: Purridge is the fourth territory in Traditional mode.
role: Capture and defend Purridge to keep its forward spawn location.
fun_facts: Purridge has more deploy spawn points than the first three flags.

name: Whisken
summary: Whisken is the fifth territory and a forward spawn location.
role: Capture and defend Whisken before the team attacks the final two territories.
fun_facts: A contested Whisken blocks forward deployment there until the fight resolves.

name: Bloodwhisk Reach
summary: Bloodwhisk Reach is the sixth territory.
role: Capture Bloodwhisk Reach to open a spawn location near Whiskspire.
fun_facts: Bloodwhisk Reach has thirteen deploy spawn points, second only to Whiskspire.

name: Whiskspire
summary: Whiskspire is the seventh and final enemy territory.
role: Capture and hold Whiskspire. The team must control this territory to start the boss fight in Traditional mode.
fun_facts: Whiskspire gives the largest forward deployment spread, with fourteen spawn points.
